description: US-007 local extraction bake-off set. Each capture is an OCR dump shaped on a real screenshot: lines with normalized top-left bboxes, provenance, and (for colour cases) flat_colors the test renders into a PNG and samples. expected_kind is the honest human label; ambiguous=true marks captures where being low_confidence is a fine outcome — but a status=extracted with the wrong kind is never acceptable.
